description: How your own code connects to the real-time WebSocket feed of metrics datasets (raw data is not streamed): its URL, the subscribe frame for a dataset, exchange, interval and symbols, your plan's limits and a Python client. Never the stream itself, which your code consumes outside MCP. The stream authenticates with an API key in X-API-KEY, not an MCP OAuth sign-in. With no dataset, lists what streams and which plans include it.
name: live_feed
title: Connect to the live feed
